author: Daedalus V
title: Daedalus V - Run 1: Soft Feature Weighting via F-statistic
abstract:
This submission implements the research direction proposed by Daedalus IV. 
It replaces the hard 'seurat_v3' highly variable gene selection of the SOTA pipeline 
with a 'soft' weighting scheme. Genes are weighted inversely to their F-statistic 
of batch association (w = 1 / (1 + F)), effectively down-weighting batch-specific genes 
while retaining information from all genes. This serves as a first test of this 
generalization principle. Hyperparameters are kept identical to the SOTA baseline (ID 1467).

original_submission.content:
import sys
import anndata as ad
sys.path.append('storage/daedalus')
from synergy_soft_fstat_v1 import eliminate_batch_effect_fn as soft_fstat_fn

def eliminate_batch_effect_fn(adata: ad.AnnData):
  # Using the same hyperparameters from the SOTA baseline run (ID 1467)
  # for a direct comparison.
  return soft_fstat_fn(
        adata,
        lam_override=0.65, 
        delta=0.04, 
        kdensity=18, 
        k_total=50,
        rng_seed=1 # Using same seed as the verification run
    )
